profile.headline: SharePoint Front-End Web Developer at TTC, Inc.
profile.summary: I specialize in bringing a rich, modern, professional UI experience to end users. Experienced working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Responsive Design and Microsoft technologies. My creative background allows me to find the ideal medium in which elements of both art and technology can collide.

positions.title: SharePoint Front-End Web Developer
positions.description:
Work with prime contract at Transportation Security Administration (TSA) to provide web development and technical support to the “Office of Finance Administration (OFA), Real Estate Management Division”. Roles and responsibilities are:
•	Design, develop and deploy branding for team sites and intranet portal to improve collaboration. 
•	Serve as Site Administrator.
•	Create and manage SharePoint document libraries, list, custom views, apps, web part, alerts, and search setup.
•	Involve in all the phases of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including
requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, UAT, production and post-
production support.
•	Provide Technical Support to end-users and resolved day-to-day issues regarding SharePoint usage.
•	Design several InfoPath forms that integrate custom workflows development.
•	Develop training materials.
•	Analyze requirements and map to SharePoint out-of-the-box solutions and extend SharePoint capabilities using CSS, HTML, and JavaScript.
•	Successfully worked on SharePoint Migration (2007 to 2010 to 2013) issues on Web Part errors and issues with existing sites.
•	Establish standard development practices to improve coding quality and productivity

positions.title: Marketing Graphic Designer
positions.description: Provided page layout for monthly publication, and also made service for the advertisement field by making flyers, posters, logo, and e-mail campaigns.

positions.title: Graphic and Web Designer
positions.description:
Lead the entire aspects of website development, from creating landing page, icons, buttons, banners and image optimization through the integration of Flash that would provide a modern look to the website, making it appealing to clients and give more visibility for various displayed products. Provided page layout of “Math and Reading” semi-annual mail-order catalogs for two publications, and also made service for the advertisement field by making flyers, banners, e-mail campaigns, product, and commercial packaging. Applied high caliber skills in taking photographs for the new products.
• Rendered expertise in the redesign of the “EAI Education” website.
• Demonstrated hands-on organization skills in optimizing the image in the website to show consistency to the displayed products. Conceptualized and created the community webpage concept.
• Took part in the redesign of “EAI Catalog, Scientific Product Division.” Drove the company to decrease expenses by owning an in-house studio as well as enhanced visual impact of the product by

positions.title: Graphic Designer/Art Director
positions.description:
Served as art director for the weekly publication called “The Source” responsible for coordinating layouts of graphics and text, distributing sections, and monitoring any progress of the assigned designers while guaranteeing that there would be no delivery errors by the weekly deadline. Created designs for flyers, posters, logo, and advertisements for internal and external clients from diverse businesses.
• Expertly worked with print production vendors to review the publication and made sure that there will be accuracy regarding the color; maintained high-standards of quality control.
• Endowed expertise and effort in the redesign of “The Source” incorporated new layout, graphics, and ad page concepts.
• Rendered assistance in initiating publication’s launching campaign effort and improving marketing strategies. Designed the Okinawa Living monthly magazine multi-page layout of publications that gave way to earn an international recognition and award.
• Contributed to feature articles, advertisements, and other internal publications by rendering skills in photography.
